row: Physio Tips with Marrow is a YouTube channel that gives helpful tips on physical therapy/physiotherapy related topics.  We share videos that informational about common disorders and give tips on home treatments when applicable.  The channel is hosted by Marrow Burnette, PT, MSPT, OCS, COMT.  Mr. Burnette is a certified orthopedic manual therapist and a board certified orthopedic specialists in physical therapy and has practiced for 23+ years.  He is also a continuing education instructor for Maitland Australian Physiotherapy https://maitlandseminars.site/.  Marrow Burnette is the owner of Australian Physiotherapy Specialists, a physical therapy clinic located in Jacksonville, Florida, USA.  http://australianpt.com/
